weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco feels clean and bright, the sky a polished sheet of blue and the air clear enough to sharpen every edge of shadow. The forecast holds that clarity through the afternoon, with sun unbroken and light that stays steady until early evening. Expect it to be frankly sunny; the UV index will bite through the middle of the day before easing toward late afternoon, so shade is your ally and the western light will grow kinder as the hours slip by.

Dress in light, breathable layers with a brimmed hat, dark glasses, and sunscreen; a touch of breeze later may freshen things but won’t demand more than short sleeves until dusk. It’s a good day for ordinary pleasures: walk your errands while the pavements are quiet, let a load of washing dry on the line, linger over a coffee at a shaded table, tend to a few plants, or take a gentle spin on the bike beneath the leafier streets. As the sun lowers and the light turns honeyed, a simple stroll to pick up dinner or a book to finish on the veranda will fit the mood of the day.
